newsitem.title: NEPAL: Japanese climber missing in Himalayas.
newsitem.headline: Japanese climber missing in Himalayas.

text.p: A Japanese climber, Masatsugu Konishi, was reported missing after scaling the 8,163-metre (26,800-foot) Mount Manaslu, Nepal's Tourism Ministry said on Monday.
Konishi, 57, from Hidaka city was one of five Japanese mountaineers who successfully scaled Mount Manaslu in the Nepalese Himalayas on September 30.
He was last seen by two fellow climbers at 2:30 a.m (2030 GMT) on October 1 while they were making their way down. Heavy snowfall blocked the descent and the climbers were stuck for three days.
Konishi was separated from the two climbers, who were unable to trace him later. Hiroaki Arikawa and Masahiko Mimura were evacuated by Nepali helicopters and brought to Kathmandu on Monday.
